alcohol-craving: Individual physiological responses were analyzed to identify candidate markers of alcohol craving.

ECG, PPG and EDA acquisition from over 100 patients and controls

Sparse graphs, limited-label learning and compact temporal attention
First-author papers in EAAI 2025, KBS 2026 and IEEE SPL 2026.
multimodal-emotion: Built an older-adult speech dataset and evaluated graph-based fusion of speech and text for emotion recognition.

KRW 20 million technology transfer and KOSOMBE Best Poster Award.

EEG, EDA and PPG feature fusion with graph neural networks
Two certified tests, one patent application and three software registrations.

Early prediction of combined disorders and treatment-response monitoring
Model and evaluation protocol design in progress.

Alignment of physiological and language inputs for efficient interaction

Research contributor; co-first author of MDA-GCL

Speech, video, text and biosignals; acquisition target above 3,300 hours

HEALLO kiosks at approximately 100 NH NongHyup Bank branches in Seoul
Industry collaboration and field deployment support.

CT/MRI registration, position tracking, ultrasound scanning and field visualization
Research prototype developed with preclinical researchers.

Co-developer of blood-pressure estimation and real-time processing

Back and seat BCG channels connected to a model server and monitoring app

Rule-based state machine with 10 specialist agents; speech, documents and dialogue
Eight synthetic personas and 384 evaluation sessions.
neurotruth: Connected wearable craving estimates and rule-based risk decisions to app notifications and conversational support.

Four-level craving estimation, state checks and dialogue; MBID remains future work
multiscale-entropy: Used moving averages to retain samples when estimating multiscale entropy from short EEG segments.

Scale-wise ROC AUC on the Bonn and Bern-Barcelona EEG datasets
Published in Mathematical Biosciences and Engineering, 2024.

11: Candidate physiomarkers of individual craving responses
Craving responses differ in magnitude and direction across individuals, limiting a single marker's explanatory power.
Synchronized video stimuli, questionnaires and physiological signals, then compared individual correlations and changes across craving levels.
Designed acquisition and quality checks at two hospitals. Conducted LMM and SHAP analyses in the expanded cohort.
The figures show two early 2025 studies: an 11-person exploration and heart-rate examples from a six-person, seven-session study. The 50-person JBHI analysis is a separate expanded study.
13: ASGCRL: adaptive graphs and contrastive learning
Incorrect connections in fixed similarity graphs can propagate errors when labels are scarce.
Updated connections with learned representations and used adaptive augmentation to preserve class relationships during contrastive learning.
Designed the method, implemented the model, conducted ablations and wrote the first-author KBS 2026 paper as a follow-up to SGCL.
SEED-IV Case 1 uses 2.4% labels and subject-wise transductive evaluation. The embedding illustration for subject 15 is distinct from aggregate accuracy.
14: A small motor-imagery model must capture multiple temporal scales and suppress noise.
Extracted temporal features with multiple kernels and recalibrated time points using parameter-free SimAM attention.
Designed the model, measured classification accuracy and CPU latency, and conducted ablations for the first-author IEEE SPL 2026 paper.
BCI Competition IV 2a, session-independent accuracy: 70.81 ± 0.49%. Complexity: 1.84K parameters and 20.69 MFLOPs. Latency: 1.46 ms on a desktop CPU, batch size 1; not a wearable-device measurement.
16: Older-adult speech: acquisition and transcription effects
Older-adult speech and transcription errors can alter text-based emotion classification.
Compared speech, original text and transcribed text using the same subject-independent split of fixed-sentence utterances.
Designed IRB and emotion-elicitation protocols, co-developed models and supported data construction and technology transfer.
The experiment involved 24 participants aged 66 to 81, seven emotions and 1,512 utterances. Transcription reduced weighted F1; adding speech did not recover this loss under the tested condition.
17: EmotionHeart: dialogue graphs and missing modalities
The model must represent speaker relationships and modality differences while retaining context when an input is missing.
Encoded within-speaker, between-speaker and cross-modal relations, then aligned modalities with an augmentation-free contrastive objective.
Designed the heterogeneous graph and alignment loss and evaluated missing modalities. First author, ICASSP 2026.
Weighted F1, averaged over 10 random splits. The full-input baseline is Transformer; the audio-only baseline is GRACE. IEMOCAP: 73.13 with all inputs and 60.26 with audio only.
19: MSGCN: fusion within and across signals
Different feature spaces and limited labels make simple feature concatenation insufficient for representing modality relationships.
First fused DE and PSD similarity within signals, then diffused cross-signal similarity and classified the resulting graph with a GCN.
Developed graph fusion and semi-supervised models and supported certification and intellectual-property outputs.
DEAP, subject-wise transductive evaluation with 120 labels per class. Valence accuracy: 97.37 ± 1.75%; arousal: 97.38 ± 1.68%. The patent is an application, not a granted patent.
21: Wearable measurements have different sampling intervals and missing-data patterns, complicating early state-change detection.
Research covers activity, sleep, HRV and skin temperature, heterogeneous relationships, and lagged information flow.
Contributing to feature construction, graph research and longitudinal state modeling.
Work is in progress. Cohort size, observation period, final architecture, prediction horizon and quantitative comparisons are not yet established.
23: Related FR-PTT encoder and dual-stream research
Contactless blood-pressure estimation requires information beyond the pulse waveform alone.
Combined pulse morphology with 28 pulse-transit-time relations among eight facial regions in a three-branch model.
Co-developed FR-PTT and contributed to its IJCNN 2026 oral presentation. Studying physiological state representations and LLM interfaces.
VitalVideos SBP/DBP MAE: 13.13/7.56 mmHg; V4V: 12.16/8.96 mmHg. These are FR-PTT paper results, not final results for the ongoing foundation model.
25: MDA-GCL: multimodal fusion and domain alignment
EEG and eye-feature distributions change across subjects and sessions.
Applied graph contrastive and domain-adversarial objectives to a graph built through modality-similarity fusion.
Co-developed the model and ablations as a co-first author and contributed to acquisition protocols.
Transductive domain adaptation uses unlabeled target features. Target emotion labels are excluded from training and model selection. SEED-IV cross-subject/session accuracy: 76.1 ± 7.4% / 83.8 ± 8.3%.
27: Remote pulse estimation and kiosk deployment
Remote pulse models need physiological representations and an inference path suitable for embedded hardware.
Aligned global and local pulse spectra from the same video to learn shared physiological components without pulse labels.
Co-developed models, converted inference to TensorRT FP16, integrated Jetson Nano and supported HEALLO field deployment.

GLCL results are from the related research manuscript. Deployment specifications, device latency and field error require separate evidence. UBFC-rPPG MAE/RMSE: 1.09/1.72 bpm; PURE: 0.26/0.42 bpm; COHFACE: 2.19/5.83 bpm.
29: Coordinate registration and real-time image slices
CT/MRI volumes, tracking devices and probes use different coordinate systems.
Connected Reference and RAS coordinates through landmark and surface registration and propagated probe transforms to image slices in real time.
Developed Python modules for 3D Slicer, integrated devices and packaged the prototype with preclinical researchers.
Figures are from the original KIST presentations. They document imaging guidance and control implementation, not therapeutic efficacy.
30: Stage movement, waveform acquisition and field maps
Stage movements accumulate waiting time, and each waveform must remain associated with its measurement location.
Adjusted VXM movement intervals and waiting times and generated plane-wise field maps from grid measurements.
Connected robotic movement, waveform acquisition and field visualization within 3D Slicer.

The original timing calculation compares 14.7 seconds with 4.4 seconds, approximately 3.3 times faster. Targeting error units, reference positions and repeated-trial validation remain to be documented.
32: Two-channel BCG model and real-time service
Temporal BCG information from the chair back and seat must be connected to real-time blood-pressure display.
Extracted local features from 10-second windows with a CNN, then used a BiGRU and temporal attention for regression.
Co-developed acquisition, modeling and real-time processing. Modularized the final TOG project into a public repository.
The original presentation figure differs from the final code in CNN channel counts. The final code uses 10 convolutional layers with 64/128/256/512 channels, a 64-unit BiGRU and temporal attention.
33: Measured resting and post-exercise states for about three hours per participant, with cuff references every two minutes.
Reported SBP and DBP errors for six participants using within-person temporal splits of 29/14/57%.
The original experiment used overlapping windows and normalization before splitting. Real-data reevaluation of the refactored code remains necessary.
The 2021 paper reports mean SBP/DBP MAE of 4.70/3.83 mmHg and RMSE of 6.02/4.90 mmHg. These are original paper results, not a new evaluation of the released refactor.
35: NeuroSync: intake, retrieval and clinician handoff
Free dialogue must populate clinical slots without allowing unsupported values into the handoff record.
A rule-based state machine runs 10 specialist agents. Scales use deterministic scoring, and final records undergo source and evidence checks.
Implemented orchestration, RAG and verification logic and integrated the patient app, clinician interface and backend.
The architecture and screens document an AI Champion prototype for clinician handoff support. It does not establish diagnoses.
36: NeuroSync: output reliability and inference cost
Verification blocked 337 unsupported candidates before final output and improved slot coverage and scale assignment.
The pre-filter unsupported-candidate ratio rose from 46.4% to 55.2%, exposing limitations at the generation stage despite final-output verification.
Further work concerns reducing calls and tokens and obtaining specialist assessment and clinical proof-of-concept evidence.

384 synthetic sessions in total, with 144 in the direct comparison. Slot coverage improved from 55.6% to 98.4%; cumulative turn waiting time increased from 4.16 to 9.04 seconds. These are synthetic evaluations, not clinical outcomes.
38: NeuroTruth: sensing, state checks and dialogue
Wearable predictions must trigger state checks and notifications while keeping dialogue separate from risk decisions.
Backend rules determine risk levels and notification timing. The app supports state confirmation, questionnaires and speech interaction.
Served as technical lead and PM; implemented risk logic, backend, notifications, Korean STT and TTS integration.
The prototype currently supports four-level craving estimation. Bio-linguistic incongruence analysis (MBID) and clinical intervention evaluation remain future work.
39: Confirmed the connection between classification, risk decisions, notifications and dialogue in 21 of 21 repeated integration tests.
A separate camera test processed 10 of 10 static videos. Mean processing time for a 20-second video was 14.8 seconds.
Next steps are MBID scoring and intervention evaluation, with clinical assessment of approximately 80 participants at two hospitals planned.

LOSO balanced accuracy: 71%; macro F1: 70%. Mean notification delay: 78.0 ms over Wi-Fi and 121.1 ms over LTE, excluding LLM response time. Camera throughput does not establish heart-rate accuracy or clinical benefit.
41: MDE-MA: multiscale analysis of short EEG
Coarse-graining reduces sample counts at larger scales, limiting entropy estimation in short segments.
Used moving averages to retain N-s+1 samples and compared scale-wise ROC AUC with MSE and coarse-grained MDE.
Analyzed short segments, compared methods and performed statistical tests. Co-first author, MBE 2024.

The Bonn A segment is a five-second interval centered on the first quartile. ROC AUC measures state separation in public EEG datasets. Bern-Barcelona evaluation distinguishes focal from non-focal EEG.

sgcl: DE와 PSD의 표본 유사도 그래프를 융합하고, 소량 레이블의 분류 손실과 그래프 대조 손실을 함께 학습했다.
Combined DE and PSD sample-similarity graphs with classification and contrastive objectives under limited labels.
SEED-IV Case 1 정확도 84.61 ± 4.20%. 레이블 2.4%, 피험자별 transductive 평가로, 새로운 피험자에 대한 일반화 성능과 구분한다.
SEED-IV Case 1 accuracy: 84.61 ± 4.20% with 2.4% labels. Subject-wise transductive evaluation, distinct from transfer to an unseen subject.
asgcrl: 표현에 따라 표본 그래프를 갱신하고 레이블 기반 증강을 적용해 고정 그래프의 잡음 연결을 줄였다.
Updated sample graphs with learned representations and used label-guided augmentation to reduce noisy connections.
SEED-IV Case 1에서 Static GCN 75.75 ± 8.95%, ASGCRL 87.31 ± 3.84%. 동일 조건 차이는 11.56%p이다.
SEED-IV Case 1: 75.75 ± 8.95% for Static GCN and 87.31 ± 3.84% for ASGCRL, a difference of 11.56 percentage points under the same protocol.
mda-gcl: 토폴로지를 반영한 모달 융합과 그래프 대조학습, 도메인 적대학습을 결합해 피험자와 세션 간 분포 차이를 다뤘다.
Combined topology-aware modality fusion, graph contrastive learning and adversarial domain adaptation for subject and session shifts.
SEED-IV 피험자 간 76.1 ± 7.4%, 세션 간 83.8 ± 8.3%. 비레이블 타깃 특징을 사용하는 transductive 평가이다.
SEED-IV accuracy: 76.1 ± 7.4% across subjects and 83.8 ± 8.3% across sessions. Evaluation is transductive and uses unlabeled target features.
simnext-eeg: 다중 시간척도 합성곱, 파라미터 없는 시간 어텐션, 분리형 정제로 작은 운동상상 EEG 디코더를 구성했다.
Built a compact motor-imagery EEG decoder using multiscale convolution, parameter-free temporal attention and separable refinement.
BCI IV 2a 세션 독립 정확도 70.81 ± 0.49%, 파라미터 1.84K, 데스크톱 CPU 지연 1.46 ms(batch size 1).
BCI IV 2a session-independent accuracy: 70.81 ± 0.49%; 1.84K parameters; 1.46 ms desktop CPU latency at batch size 1.
sparse-dgcnn: EEG 전극 그래프에 행 단위 ℓ₂,₁ 희소성을 적용하고, proximal 갱신으로 불필요한 연결을 줄였다.
Applied row-wise ℓ₂,₁ sparsity and proximal updates to a learned EEG electrode graph.
DE 특징의 피험자 독립 정확도는 SEED 78.36 ± 9.53%, SEED-IV 47.67 ± 6.67%. 공개 예제는 합성 데이터 실행이며 원논문 재현 결과가 아니다.
With DE features, subject-independent accuracy is 78.36 ± 9.53% on SEED and 47.67 ± 6.67% on SEED-IV. The public synthetic example does not reproduce the benchmark results.
multiscale-entropy: 이동평균으로 짧은 EEG의 표본 수를 유지하고, 다중척도 분포 엔트로피의 상태 분리 성능을 비교했다.
Preserved samples through moving averages and compared multiscale distribution entropy for state separation in short EEG.
Bonn과 Bern-Barcelona 공개 EEG에서 척도별 ROC AUC를 평가했다. 큰 척도에서의 표본 감소 문제를 분석했다.
Evaluated scale-wise ROC AUC on Bonn and Bern-Barcelona EEG, focusing on sample loss at larger scales.
nacl: 대화를 이종 그래프로 표현하고, 마스킹 복원과 이웃 기반 교차모달 대조 정렬로 감정 표현을 학습한다.
Represents dialogues as heterogeneous graphs and learns emotion representations through masked reconstruction and neighborhood-based cross-modal alignment.
MELD 사전학습과 IEMOCAP 전이, 입력 모달 결손을 평가한다. 공개 저장소에 사전학습, 미세조정, 평가 설정을 제공한다.
Studies MELD pretraining, transfer to IEMOCAP and missing input modalities. The repository provides pretraining, fine-tuning and evaluation configurations.
craving-physiomarkers: VR로 유발한 단계별 알코올 갈망에서 ECG, PPG, EDA 후보 생리지표를 분석했다.
Analyzed ECG, PPG and EDA candidate physiomarkers of graded alcohol craving elicited in VR.
50명, 1,697 trial, 152개 특징을 대상으로 혼합효과 모형과 SHAP 분석을 수행했다. 후보 지표 연구이며 임상 진단 성능과 구분한다.
The expanded analysis includes 50 participants, 1,697 trials and 152 features, using mixed-effects models and SHAP. Candidate-marker analysis is distinct from diagnostic validation.
dls-gcn: 거리별 그래프 지지집합과 시차를 공유하는 잔차 인접행렬로 상상 발화 EEG의 시공간 관계를 표현한다.
Models imagined-speech EEG with distance-specific graph supports and residual adjacency shared across temporal lags.
동일 프로토콜의 피험자 의존 평가: BCI Competition Track 3 정확도 84.33 ± 4.59%, Thinking Out Loud 41.08 ± 2.60%. 공개 실행기는 Track 3에 해당한다.
Matched subject-dependent accuracy: 84.33 ± 4.59% on BCI Competition Track 3 and 41.08 ± 2.60% on Thinking Out Loud. The released runner covers Track 3.
glcl-rppg: 얼굴 영상의 전역 및 국소 맥파 스펙트럼을 대조 정렬해 심박 레이블 없이 표현을 학습한다.
Aligns global and local pulse spectra from facial video to learn representations without heart-rate labels.
원고의 UBFC-rPPG MAE 1.09 bpm, PURE 0.26 bpm, COHFACE 2.19 bpm. 실제 키오스크의 현장 오차와 구분한다.
Manuscript MAE: 1.09 bpm on UBFC-rPPG, 0.26 on PURE and 2.19 on COHFACE. These are separate from kiosk field errors.
axis-ecg: 12유도 ECG의 국소 구간과 전역 관계를 순차적으로 처리하는 1D Swin Transformer와 two-way 다중 레이블 손실을 연구한다.
Studies local-then-global 1D Swin attention and a two-way multilabel loss for 12-lead ECG classification.
PTB-XL fold 10, 1,000회 bootstrap 평균. AXIS (4,2)의 Macro AUROC 0.9327, 파라미터 644,631개. 모델과 손실 구현을 공개했으며 독립 학습 파이프라인은 준비 중이다.
PTB-XL fold 10, means over 1,000 bootstrap resamples: AXIS (4,2) Macro AUROC 0.9327 with 644,631 parameters. Model and loss code are available; the standalone training pipeline is pending.
fr-ptt: 얼굴 부위 간 맥파 전달시간, 파형 형태, 파형 인코더를 결합해 비접촉 혈압을 추정했다.
Combined facial pulse transit time, pulse morphology and a waveform encoder for contactless blood-pressure estimation.
VitalVideos SBP/DBP MAE 13.13/7.56 mmHg, V4V 12.16/8.96 mmHg. IJCNN 2026 구두 발표, 제2저자로 공동 개발에 참여했다.
SBP/DBP MAE: 13.13/7.56 mmHg on VitalVideos and 12.16/8.96 mmHg on V4V. Co-developed the model as second author; oral presentation at IJCNN 2026.
emotionheart: 화자와 모달 관계를 이종 그래프로 인코딩하고, 교차모달 대조 정렬로 대화 감정 인식을 수행했다.
Encoded speaker and modality relationships in a heterogeneous graph and aligned modalities for conversational emotion recognition.
Weighted F1: IEMOCAP 73.13%, MELD 68.99%. 음성만 남긴 IEMOCAP 조건에서는 60.26%이며, 전체 입력과 결손 조건의 기준 모델이 다르다.
Weighted F1: 73.13% on IEMOCAP and 68.99% on MELD. Audio-only IEMOCAP reaches 60.26%; full-input and missing-modality comparisons use different baselines.
idcl: 서로 다른 대화의 이웃 표현을 양성 쌍으로 선택해 음성과 텍스트를 대조 정렬했다.
Selected neighboring representations across dialogues as positive pairs for audio-text contrastive alignment.
MELD 사전학습 후 IEMOCAP 4분류 weighted F1 85.8%, 6분류 66.6%. 제2저자이자 ICASSP 2026 구두 발표자로 참여했다.
With MELD pretraining, IEMOCAP weighted F1 is 85.8% for four classes and 66.6% for six classes. Second author and oral presenter at ICASSP 2026.
balanced-rppg: 균형 대조학습을 이용해 얼굴 영상에서 원격 심박을 추정했다.
Used balanced contrastive learning for remote heart-rate estimation from facial video.
ICEIC 2025 구두 발표 논문. 제2저자로 참여했으며 DOI와 관련 연구 저장소를 연결했다. GLCL 후속 원고의 수치와 구분한다.
Oral paper at ICEIC 2025, contributed as second author. DOI and the related research repository are provided. Results from the later GLCL manuscript are not attributed to this paper.
global-emotion-fusion: 대화의 전역 정보를 융합해 다중모달 감정 인식을 수행한 초기 연구이다.
An earlier study of global information fusion for multimodal emotion recognition in conversations.
ITC-CSCC 2024 제1저자 구두 발표. 이후 대화 관계와 모달 정렬을 다루는 EmotionHeart 연구로 확장했다.
First-author oral paper at ITC-CSCC 2024. Subsequent work on dialogue relations and modality alignment includes EmotionHeart.
graph-transformer-eeg: 준지도 EEG 감정 인식을 위해 판별적 그래프 Transformer 모델을 연구했다.
Studied a discriminative graph Transformer for semi-supervised EEG emotion recognition.
IEEE ICCE-Asia 2023 제1저자 구두 발표. 논문의 상세 실험 조건과 결과는 연결된 원문에서 확인할 수 있다.
First-author oral paper at IEEE ICCE-Asia 2023. The linked paper provides experimental conditions and results.
pdc-gcn: Partial Directed Coherence로 EEG 채널의 연결 관계를 구성하고 스펙트럴 GCN으로 감정을 분류했다.
Constructed EEG channel relationships with Partial Directed Coherence and classified emotions with a spectral GCN.
IEEE ICCE-Asia 2022 제1저자 구두 발표. EEG 연결성 기반 그래프 학습의 초기 연구이다.
First-author oral paper at IEEE ICCE-Asia 2022, representing early work on EEG connectivity-based graph learning.
damc-net: 시간 및 공간 분기의 다중척도 합성곱, SimAM, 로그 파워 집계로 상상 발화 EEG를 분류한다.
Classifies imagined-speech EEG using temporal and spatial multiscale branches, SimAM and log-power aggregation.
BCI Competition Track 3의 15명, 5개 단어를 대상으로 한 피험자 의존 모델. 구현 기준 파라미터 55,749개이며 AAAI 심사 중이다.
A subject-dependent model for 15 participants and five words in BCI Competition Track 3. The implementation has 55,749 parameters; the manuscript is under review at AAAI.
